description: This file defines a Dart class `ApiKeySecureStore` that provides secure storage functionality for an OpenAI API key using the `flutter_secure_storage` package. It includes methods to load, save, and clear the API key, encapsulating interactions with platform-specific secure storage.

classes.name: ApiKeySecureStore
classes.description: A wrapper for securely storing and retrieving the OpenAI API key utilizing platform keychain/keystore via `flutter_secure_storage`.

methods.name: loadOpenAIApiKey
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the stored OpenAI API key, returning null if not set or empty.

methods.name: saveOpenAIApiKey
methods.description: Asynchronously saves the provided API key securely; if the value is empty or whitespace, it clears the stored key.

methods.name: clearOpenAIApiKey
methods.description: Asynchronously clears the stored OpenAI API key.
